set.body:
From the S5.2 review (61cc2da). Data.dc.html:145-147 places 'Column mapping | Trial metadata' in the Data perspective dock pane, tagged 'Dataset · re-admit'; :267 'Mapping and geometry changes apply when r3 is admitted'. S5.2 ships the wizard as a File › Import window; ImportWizard.remap has no caller and data.column-mapping is still a placeholder (StudioLayouts.scala:84), so a user cannot re-map an existing dataset.

Acceptance: the column-mapping pane hosts the wizard view-model for the selected dataset revision (remap target), re-reading sources from the project; a re-map dispatches the single ReviseDataset command; board parity against Data.dc.html column-mapping section; FX test from Data perspective selection to re-admit.
set.title: Host the import wizard in the Data column-mapping pane (re-map reachable from the UI)
